sources.observation: 2026-07 project update lists MagpieTTS v2607 and German among supported languages.

observed_facts.zero_shot_voice_cloning: removed in current release for security reasons

german_vendor_eval.scope: vendor held-out evaluation; not F2 room-audio or human naturalness evidence

observed_facts.standard_mode_limit: up to 20 seconds generated speech per request

benchmark_recommendation.first_low_risk_native_runtime: Use the explicitly documented v2602 F16 GGUF + NanoCodec NeMo-Speech.cpp path as the native-runtime baseline, then separately test v2607 Python/NeMo for quality before claiming any v2607 native C++ equivalence.
benchmark_recommendation.promotion_gate: Do not promote beyond source scope until a local component run proves actual generation and measures whether audio can be emitted/cancelled incrementally enough for Frankenstein barge-in.

negative_evidence: The primary model card documents utterance/batch and long-form synthesis but does not establish true incremental streaming audio output.
The model card's native NeMo-Speech.cpp example currently names a v2602 GGUF artifact, not an explicit v2607 GGUF artifact.
Vendor CER/SSIM is upstream evidence and cannot substitute for F2 German room-audio, naturalness, latency or cancellation measurements.
